parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The name and dimension information of the configuration item.

AllowHangup: allows agents to hang up inbound calls.   

ShowCalledID: controls the display of inbound caller numbers.

ShowCalleeID: controls the display of outbound callee numbers.

AutoAnswerCall: controls auto-answering of inbound calls.

AudioDownload: controls recording download.

AllowChooseSkillGroup: allows agents to select skill groups for logon.

enableRecord: controls agent-side recording.

SettingWorkbenchLogLevel: sets the workbench log level.

SatisfactionSurvey: controls satisfaction survey settings.

SmsSatisfactionSurvey: controls SMS satisfaction survey settings.



Example: `{"Name":"AllowHangup","DimensionName":"instance"}`. Name specifies the configuration item name, and DimensionName specifies the configuration dimension name. The parameter name ConfigItem.1 indicates that only one configuration item is retrieved. To retrieve two configuration items, specify both ConfigItem.1 and ConfigItem.2
parameters.help_zh:
配置项名称及维度信息。

AllowHangup  允许坐席呼入挂机   

ShowCalledID 来电号码显示

ShowCalleeID 外呼号码显示

AutoAnswerCall 接听来电

AudioDownload 录音下载

AllowChooseSkillGroup 允许坐席选择技能组登录

enableRecord 坐席侧录音

SettingWorkbenchLogLevel 工作台日志等级

SatisfactionSurvey 满意度设置

SmsSatisfactionSurvey 短信满意度设置



例如：`{“Name”:”AllowHangup”,”DimensionName”:”instance”}`。其中，Name为配置项名称，DimensionName为配置维度名称。这里参数名称为ConfigItem.1意为只获取1个配置项，如果要获取两个配置项，则需要有ConfigItem.1以及ConfigItem.2
